desc:
🐛 A SANDWORM LIVES INSIDE YOU! Feed it, grow it, then UNLEASH it as a GIANT SANDWORM and swallow the desert! 🏜️

🍖 EAT EVERYTHING: crates, camels, cars, tanks, helicopters, trains... even the trees and rocks!
🧬 EVOLVE: 40 forms, from a tiny Hatchling to the five-headed SAND GOD
🌪️ UNLEASH: fill your frenzy bar and burst out of the dunes as a giant worm
🔁 MOLT: rebirth to grow stronger and open new worlds
🗺️ 5 WORLDS: Desert, Canyon, Volcano, Tundra and City
🎁 Skins, perks, upgrades and playtime gifts
🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console!

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite to get the next update!
